enumDescriptions: Keep comments that tell the reader something the code doesn't.
Keep only intent, warnings, API docs and references.
Remove every comment except tool directives and licences.

threshold.description: How sure Jev must be (0 to 1) before a comment is flagged.

ignore.description: Globs to skip, relative to this file, on top of .gitignore.

shorten.description: Rewrite comments that are kept but could say the same in fewer words, using Claude. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
